fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2025-06-28, around 02:40, Rajesh Krishnan, aged 19, a college student, did not return after leaving for a local errand; last known location was near Kadal Nagar Bus Stand Area, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-06-28. The complaint was lodged by Dharani Thangaraj (9000000307), a family member of Rajesh Krishnan, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000167. The complainant could not identify the person involved. Siva Muthu (9000000256), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Student reportedly left for college and could not be contacted afterwards.
fields.Keywords: missing person, student, bus stand, associate, CCTV, night
